quote: I am an environment artist creating high and low poly assets for several projects including the game Wayward Realms. After fighting several other apps and spending too much money SculptForge fits like a hand-made glove. While there is much to love about this software I am glad I found something that actually makes sense.
name: Richard Throgmorton (MakIt3D)

quote: You add it so quick !!? On Saturday !? Wow !
name: GABO - Gabriel Abdala

quote: After years of struggling with expensive software subscriptions, finding SculptForge felt like a breath of fresh air. It is evolving fast, with new improvements arriving regularly, and I genuinely believe it has a bright future. What excites me most is how it is made: artists steering and agents building is a monumental change in how software gets developed. My advice as a Senior Lead Character & Creature Artist and mentor: don't chase millions of polygons. Plan your models, build your forms intelligently, and add detail when needed. I strongly recommend every artist give it a try.
name: Abhik Mitra (VOIDART ACADEMY)
